mentions.name: HailPass
mentions.description: This service integrates open weather data sources (mostly NWS/NOAA plus impact reporters, with a small hail-specific ML model in development) to give Front Range residents a 5-10 minute heads-up before damaging hail arrives at their location. Prediction accuracy is still being tuned, with a target release of April 2027.
mentions.problem: Damaging hail can strike the Front Range with little warning, and weather prediction is hard; the service is being tuned to cut down false alarms before release.
mentions.source_excerpt: HailPass: https://hailpass.com similarly is a notify-before-pain service that integrates a bunch of open weather services (NWS/NOAA mostly, plus a handful of impact reporters and working on a small hail-specific ML model) to give folks on the Front Range 5-10m heads-up before damaging hail arrives at their location.
